title: Desenvolvedor React Native Pleno | Aceitação PJ | Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoa com Deficiência
description:
Sobre o PicPay


Com mais de dez anos de história, o PicPay é um ecossistema completo de serviços financeiros e não-financeiros que tem como objetivo atender as necessidades diárias de milhares de pessoas e negócios, tornando-se a sua principal conta do dia a dia.

Fundada em Vitória (ES), a empresa já conta com mais de 35 milhões de clientes ativos e faz parte do grupo J&F, um dos maiores conglomerados empresariais do Brasil. A companhia atua em diversas frentes, como Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Física, Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Jurídica, Investimentos e PicPay Shop.

Pautados pela nossa cultura, seguimos no propósito de dar muito mais pique para a vida de milhões de brasileiros. Conheça nossos valores: Atitude de Dono(a), Disciplina, Determinação, Disponibilidade, Simplicidade, Humildade e Franqueza.

O respeito, a ética, a busca pela equidade e a valorização da pluralidade são elementos inegociáveis e fazem parte da prática no nosso dia a dia aqui no PicPay. Por isso, esta vaga está aberta para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, religião, etnia, deficiência, idade, orientação sexual ou qualquer outro fator.


Conheça melhor a unidade de negócio que essa vaga pertence:

Nossa unidade PicPay Negócios , tem a missão de simplificar a vida de "quem vende alguma coisa". Da grande empresa ao pequeno empreendedor. Por aqui, você fará parte da construção e desenvolvimento de produtos e serviços que simplificam a vida de milhões de brasileiros e empresas.


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos buscando uma pessoa desenvolvedora Pleno com experiência em React Native para contribuir no desenvolvimento de soluções móveis modernas e escaláveis. Procuramos alguém que goste de desafios, valorize boas práticas e esteja comprometido(a) com a entrega de produtos de alta qualidade.


Responsabilidade e atribuições:


  • Tenha paixão por tecnologia e se mantenha atualizado(a) com as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento mobile;
  • Participe das rotinas do time, propondo ideias e soluções alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio;
  • Tenha senso de dono sobre o que desenvolve, garantindo a qualidade e performance do código;
  • Colabore com a evolução de métricas e processos do time, propondo melhorias sempre que possível;
  • Trabalhe em equipe, compartilhando conhecimentos e promovendo boas práticas;
  • Contribua com feedbacks e receba-os de forma construtiva, em um ambiente colaborativo;
  • Busque o seu autodesenvolvimento e evolua profissionalmente de forma contínua.


Requisitos e qualificações:


Hard Skills:

  • Experiência prática com React Native no desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis;
  • Proficiência em JavaScript e TypeScript ;
  • Familiaridade com padrões de gerenciamento de estado como Redux ou MobX ;
  • Experiência na integração de APIs RESTful e WebSocket;
  • Conhecimento em design responsivo e desenvolvimento de componentes reutilizáveis;
  • Experiência básica com automação de testes (ex.: unitários e integrados com Jest);
  • Conhecimento em práticas de versionamento com Git ;
  • Noções de performance e otimização para dispositivos móveis;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging, como Firebase .

Soft Skills:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em times multidisciplinares;
  • Foco em resolução de problemas e entrega de valor;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidades interpessoais;
  • Proatividade para propor melhorias e aprender continuamente.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento básico em desenvolvimento nativo (Kotlin e/ou Swift);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Expo ;
  • Noções sobre acessibilidade e inclusão digital em aplicativos móveis;
  • Experiência com CI/CD pipelines para entrega contínua.


O que oferecemos:

Saúde e Bem-estar

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programa Lado a Lado, com apoio jurídico, social, psicológico e financeiro;
  • TotalPass.

Alimentação/ Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho:

  • Cartão de crédito PicPay Benefícios , com ampla aceitação, onde você recebe seu saldo de Alimentação/Refeição e Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho (de acordo com o seu contrato de trabalho).

Licença Paternidade e Maternidade:

  • Licença Maternidade estendida de 6 meses, e de Paternidade também estendida de 20 dias.
  • Programa "Novo Ser", que acompanha nossas mamães durante toda a gestação e no retorno da licença. Falando nisso, ao retornar da licença maternidade, as mamães ainda contam com a ajuda do Auxílio Creche e também os papais que possuem guarda unilateral ou compartilhada.

Reconhecemos resultados: PPR- Participação nos Resultados do PicPay.

title: Junior QA Engineer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote QA Engineer with 6 months to 2 years of work experience, preferably quality assurance related, to join the software engineering team of our U.S. client. The right candidate must have a passion for delivering seriously cool technology on time, utilizing industry best practices, and working in a fast-paced environment.

Our client is on a mission to make people more productive by providing cloud-based document management and file sharing solutions that automate routine, repetitive tasks. They are a subsidiary of a publicly traded company that trades on the London Stock Exchange. With hundreds of thousands of users already onboard today, our client is in growth mode, developing new products to serve the U.S., the United Kingdom, and the Australian and New Zealand markets.


Responsibilities

  • Work with the Scrum Team to understand new features
  • Translate user stories into detailed working test cases to ensure that the test scope is adequate
  • Analyze test results to ensure correct functionality and interact with the team for the resolution of defects
  • Ensure complete testing-related documentation (e.g., JIRA and Confluence pages)
  • Participate in software releases
  • Work on all team tasks independently with minimal need for oversight, as well as display a willingness to ask questions when needed to remain efficient
  • Exercise a bias towards action but understand when to pause and reflect
  • Take pride and interest in your work


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and collaboration skills
  • 6 months to 2 years of work experience
  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university OR relevant work experience instead of a degree
  • Working knowledge of Agile development practices
  • Proficient in learning technology quickly
  • High attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office-type tools (e.g., Excel and Word)
  • Ability to logically break down various testing paths to cover all possible scenarios


Preferred Experience (Not required)

  • General quality assurance experience
  • JavaScript development experience
  • Performance testing experience
  • Selenium, Postman, or Nightwatch experience
  • AWS knowledge and experience
  • Azure VM experience
  • Working knowledge of SQL


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote QA Engineer with 6 months to 2 years of work experience, preferably quality assurance related, to join the software engineering team of our U.S. client. The right candidate must have a passion for delivering seriously cool technology on time, utilizing industry best practices, and working in a fast-paced environment.

Our client is on a mission to make people more productive by providing cloud-based document management and file sharing solutions that automate routine, repetitive tasks. They are a subsidiary of a publicly traded company that trades on the London Stock Exchange. With hundreds of thousands of users already onboard today, our client is in growth mode, developing new products to serve the U.S., the United Kingdom, and the Australian and New Zealand markets.


Responsibilities

  • Work with the Scrum Team to understand new features
  • Translate user stories into detailed working test cases to ensure that the test scope is adequate
  • Analyze test results to ensure correct functionality and interact with the team for the resolution of defects
  • Ensure complete testing-related documentation (e.g., JIRA and Confluence pages)
  • Participate in software releases
  • Work on all team tasks independently with minimal need for oversight, as well as display a willingness to ask questions when needed to remain efficient
  • Exercise a bias towards action but understand when to pause and reflect
  • Take pride and interest in your work


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and collaboration skills
  • 6 months to 2 years of work experience
  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university OR relevant work experience instead of a degree
  • Working knowledge of Agile development practices
  • Proficient in learning technology quickly
  • High attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office-type tools (e.g., Excel and Word)
  • Ability to logically break down various testing paths to cover all possible scenarios


Preferred Experience (Not required)

  • General quality assurance experience
  • JavaScript development experience
  • Performance testing experience
  • Selenium, Postman, or Nightwatch experience
  • AWS knowledge and experience
  • Azure VM experience
  • Working knowledge of SQL


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Android Engineer
description:
Pride Global is hiring an Android Engineer in Brazil. Please apply for consideration!!


Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: Temporary.


Job summary:

We’re looking for a skilled developer to help expand our global reach through high-quality Android features and seamless internationalization.

As part of our mobile engineering team, you’ll work across the full development lifecycle—owning features from concept to launch, collaborating with designers and backend engineers, and contributing to a platform used by millions. Your work will directly influence how guests engage with our platform around the world.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop, maintain, and support Android features and functionality
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on new features and visual design enhancements
  • Perform thorough code reviews and uphold best practices
  • Own your tasks from start to finish, communicating progress and blockers clearly
  • Manage your workload using Jira and stay organized in a fast-paced environment


What We’re Looking For

  • Professional English fluency (written and spoken)
  • 4+ years of software engineering experience building Android applications at scale
  • Strong skills in Kotlin or Java
  • Experience with Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Coroutines
  • Working knowledge of GraphQL
  • Backend experience (APIs, databases, Kubernetes) is a plus
  • Ability to thrive independently in a remote team setting
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

description:
Requisitos: Superior completo em Sistemas de Informação, Ciências ou Engenharia da Computação ou áreas similares; Conhecimento sólido em SQL e PL/SQL; Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento utilizando Oracle Forms/Reports, APEX, Java, XML e Web Services; Familiaridade com modelagem de banco de dados Oracle; Habilidades de resolução de problemas e depuração; Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em um ambiente ágil. Diferenciais: Certificações Oracle relacionadas a APEX ou PL/SQL, Forms/Reports; Experiência com outras tecnologias Oracle, como WebLogic, SOA Suite, etc; Conhecimento em front-end (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). Responsabilidades: Desenvolver, manter e otimizar aplicações baseadas em Oracle Forms/Reports, APEX e outras tecnologias relacionadas; Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócios e traduzi-los em soluções técnicas eficientes; Criar e manter procedimentos armazenados, pacotes PL/SQL e lógica de negócios no banco de dados Oracle; Implementar integrações com sistemas externos por meio de Web Services e XML; Participar de projetos de modernização, migrando aplicações legadas para o Oracle APEX. Perfil comportamental e/ou técnico de cada área: DTA: Diferenciais: Conhecimento em integrações SAP e EBS nos diferenciais Petrobras: Diferenciais: Participação em projetos de modernização, especialmente na migração de aplicações legadas para o Oracle APEX.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) PEGA – Automação e Integração de Sistemas
description:
➡️Formação

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;


➡️Nível de experiência

Sênior


➡️Setor

TI/Telecom


➡️Local de atuação

100% Remoto


Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento na plataforma PEGA, com forte atuação em projetos integrados, para compor nosso time de tecnologia em iniciativas de alta complexidade e transformação digital.

➡️Requisitos e Qualificações

3 a 5 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento de soluções na plataforma Pega.


➡️Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

Atuar em projetos de automação de processos utilizando a plataforma PEGA.

Desenvolver e manter aplicações com foco em BPM (Business Process Management) e Case Management.

Integrar sistemas legados e modernos via REST/SOAP APIs, conectores e serviços PEGA. Participar da definição de arquitetura de soluções e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Realizar testes unitários, funcionais e suporte à homologação.

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares em ambientes ágeis.


➡️Conhecimentos Técnicos:

Experiência com desenvolvimento na plataforma PEGA PRPC (versões 7.x, 8.x ou superior). Conhecimento em PEGA Rules, Flows, Activities, Data Pages, Reports, UI Rules.

Experiência com integrações de sistemas, SOAP/REST, JMS, MQ.

Desejável conhecimento em DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes e CI/CD com PEGA.


➡️Certificações:

Certified Pega System Architect (CPSA)

Certified Pega Senior System Architect (CPSSA)

title: AWS DevOps  - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are you going to do?

  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in DevOps;
  • At least 5 years of overall professional experience (Infrastructure, Software Development, or related areas);
  • Mandatory experience with AWS Cloud (design, implementation, and maintenance of solutions);
  • Strong coding practices and proven ability to automate processes;
  • Good level of English, at least B2 (Mandatory);
  • Willingness to move to Portugal (Mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you at


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for one year period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor – Full-Time)

Candidates must apply with an online portfolio in order to be considered.


WHO YOU ARE

You’re a highly creative, socially fluent designer who knows how to make people stop scrolling. You understand how content performs across platforms like TikTok and Instagram and know how to turn ideas into visuals that feel native, authentic, and viral.

You’re fluent in visual storytelling — from layouts and typography to repurposing video stills or designing carousels that tell a story. You think about content as part of a bigger narrative, not just a single post. You love collaborating with others, working fast, and iterating based on feedback.


WHAT WE NEED

ODDITY is seeking a Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor) to join our Growth Marketing and Organic Social team as we launch a new brand under the ODDITY portfolio.

This role will help define how the brand looks and feels across social media — shaping everything from post design to campaign visuals and creator-led content. You’ll translate ideas into cohesive, scroll-stopping creative that drives engagement, conversation, and brand awareness. We’re looking for someone who’s deeply tuned into social trends, understands the balance of storytelling and aesthetics, and can bring a strategic eye to organic social design.

Note: Our team works EST hours, and candidates should be available during standard business hours.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design a variety of assets for organic and paid social , including carousels, post graphics, stories, and light video edits
  • Help establish the visual identity for a new ODDITY brand , ensuring consistency and cohesion across platforms
  • Partner with marketing and creative teams to interpret briefs and bring ideas to life in visually impactful ways
  • Repurpose and adapt content for different social formats and trends
  • Collaborate closely with copywriters, growth leads, and creators to build assets that feel fresh, social-first, and culturally relevant


YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design for marketing or social media
  • Proficient in Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (After Effects or Premiere a plus, but not required)
  • Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy
  • Proven ability to design for social performance — balancing brand polish with native, engaging formats
  • Basic familiarity with AI design tools and interest in emerging creative technologies
  • Strong attention to detail and time management
  • Excellent communication skills and openness to collaboration and feedback
  • Impressive work ethic and willingness to work in a fast-paced and high-growth environment
  • Full written and spoken English proficiency


BONUS POINTS

  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram aesthetics and trends
  • Experience supporting brand launches or rebrands


WHO WE ARE

ODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. Using data science, AI, and tech innovation, we serve over 40 million users through personalized product experiences.

ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE and SpoiledChild, and is now building its next breakthrough brand — launching soon.


With headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, and a biotechnology lab in Boston, ODDITY operates at the intersection of tech, science, and creativity. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and impact-driven — ideal for those who thrive on building from the ground up.

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a People Operations Specialist to join our growing global HR team. This role will be an Individual Contributor (IC) position, focused on managing core People Ops activities and supporting employees across multiple regions. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter, detail-oriented, and collaborative professional with experience in global organizations and the ability to work across time zones.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end People Operations processes across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, and other employment changes.
  • Provide support to employees and stakeholders globally, ensuring consistent and seamless People Operations across regions.
  • Maintain and update HR systems (primarily HiBob, with exposure to Microsoft Office and HRIS tools) to ensure accurate employee records and reporting.
  • Partner with hiring managers and global HR peers to deliver guidance, promote best practices, and ensure compliance with internal policies.
  • Handle confidential employee data with the highest level of discretion, accuracy, and compliance with data privacy requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve HR processes, streamline workflows, and enhance communication throughout the employee lifecycle.
  • Contribute to employee engagement initiatives, helping foster cultural alignment and connection within a distributed workforce.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in HR/People Operations, ideally in a tech or fast-paced global organization.
  • Strong working knowledge of HR processes and compliance frameworks globally.
  • Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., HiBob, Workday, Greenhouse, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across cultures and time zones.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.


Soft Skills

  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Problem-solving mindset with flexibility to adapt in a dynamic environment.
  • High level of integrity and confidentiality.


Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a fully remote role.
  • Exposure to global HR operations and cross-cultural teams.
  • Clear career growth opportunities within a scaling People Ops team.
  • Be part of a collaborative and supportive environment focused on innovation and impact.

title: Senior Software Engineer – LLM / AI-Enabled Systems
description:
About Health Note

Health Note is building AI-powered digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. Instead of rigid,disconnected software modules, ourassistants gain skills over time — from handling simple reschedules to managing complex intake, referrals, and medication refills. Patients experience a natural,empathetic interaction, while providers gain a system that is reliable, transparent, and continually improving. Our goal is to deliver a concierge experience forevery patient, and a scalable path to automation for every clinic.


About the Role

This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible fordeveloping and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.

At Health Note, we’re not building new AI models — we’re using services to deliver digital

assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. These assistants grow new skills over time, handle complex patient-facing workflows safely andreliably, and transform healthcare operations into a continuous improvement process. The result is not just reliable automation, but a human and empatheticexperience that patients and providers trust.

As part of a cross-functional team, you’ll collaborate with product managers, solution engineers, and client experience managers to create world-class, AI-enabled solutions. You’ll shape architectural decisions, integration patterns, and developer workflows so that AI isn’t just “bolted on,” but thoughtfullyincorporated into our platform.

This opportunity is ideal if you want to take the next step in your career and join a growth-stage organization focused on healthcare — while working at thefrontier of AI-enabled software development.

We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronouscommunication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.

Our cutting-edge stack is full-stack Typescript leveraging NestJS, React, Remix, Tailwinds,GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pulumi, all on AWS. Our architecture isservice oriented and managed in a Monorepo.


Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and performant servicesand applications.
  • Integrate LLMs and AI services into production systems, with attention tosafety, observability, performance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Build abstractions, APIs, and internal tooling that make it easier for otherengineers and product teams to leverage AI responsibly.
  • Continually improve the codebase and test coverage through refactoring,automated testing, CI/CD, and strong developer productivity practices.
  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies and evaluate their fit for ourproducts, balancing speed-to-market with reliability.
  • Mentor and support other engineers, setting coding standards andarchitectural practices that ensure long-term maintainability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design AI-enabled productexperiences that meet real client needs.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building robust, scalable full-stack applications,databases, and developer tools.
  • Hands-on experience working with LLMs or AI services (e.g., OpenAI,Anthropic, Vertex AI, Llama) in a professional or personal capacity.
  • Significant experience designing, building, deploying, and maintainingproduction applications at scale.
  • Proficiency with Javascript/Typescript, React, NodeJS (NestJS), andPostgresQL.
  • Familiarity with modern web technologies (HTTP2, WebSockets, gRPC,GraphQL).
  • Comfort architecting solutions to ambiguous problems with significantimpact.
  • Experience leaving the codebase better than you found it throughautomated testing, CI/CD, and observability.


Nice to Haves

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI-enabled features (e.g.,measuring quality, accuracy, and reliability of LLM outputs).
  • Familiarity with RAG, embedding algorithms, and intent classification.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring systems (Langfuse,Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, Cloudwatch, etc.).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code in production.
  • Familiarity with internal UI and integration tools (ReTool, SalesforceCommunities, Contentful, NextJS, etc.).
  • Experience with containers and orchestrators like Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Background in healthcare, regulated industries, or EHR/EMR integration.
  • Experience debugging distributed systems.


You do not need to have prior experience with every technology in our stack. We believe great candidates are capable of learning new tools quickly, and weprovide mentorship and guidance as needed.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Recruiting Manager - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Recruitment Manager to join our Recruiting Team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. This person must be proactive, detail-oriented, and demonstrate excellent analytical abilities, as well as teamwork and multitasking skills. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry! to accompany our strategic growth objectives in hiring personnel and key roles.


Key responsibilities:


- Collaborate in the definition and execution of the talent attraction strategy.

- Plan alternative scenarios of recruitment according to business needs.

- Design and validate best practices for the attraction, search, and selection of professionals for our vacancies in collaboration with leaders and Managers.

- Provide new ideas and solutions aimed at improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the selection processes, methods, and technology.

- Preparation of reports and metrics.


Requirements:


- At least 5 years of experience as a recruiter.

- Experience in leading teams of at least 5 people.

- Good interpersonal relationships.

- Knowledge of the IT market, both of development professionals and business profiles.

- Good command of English to get by on a day-to-day basis.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (.NET e Angular)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full-Stack Sênior para integrar nosso time e contribuir com soluções robustas e escaláveis! Se você gosta de desafios, trabalha bem em ambientes colaborativos e tem experiência em .NET, Angular e Microsoft Azure, essa vaga é para você!


Descrição das atividades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web completas, incluindo front-end (Angular) e back-end (.NET);
  • Integrar APIs e serviços utilizando práticas modernas de segurança e escalabilidade;
  • Projetar e implementar soluções na nuvem utilizando o Microsoft Azure;
  • Criar e gerenciar Azure Functions para orquestração de serviços e automação;
  • Participar do ciclo de vida completo do desenvolvimento, incluindo design, testes e deploy;
  • Trabalhar com Kubernetes para orquestração e gerenciamento de contêineres;
  • Colaborar com equipes de design, DevOps e gerentes de projetos para garantir entregas de alta qualidade;
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs, além de otimizar o desempenho de aplicações;
  • Manter e evoluir sistemas legados desenvolvidos em .NET Framework, Windows Forms e Windows Services.


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento em .NET (C#) e Angular;
  • Conhecimento sólido em tecnologias legadas: .NET Framework, Windows Forms e Windows Services ;
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de microsserviços e consumo de APIs RESTful;
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Azure, incluindo Azure Functions, App Services e bancos de dados na nuvem;
  • Boas práticas de versionamento utilizando Git;
  • Experiência com práticas de CI/CD em pipelines de deploy na nuvem;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes para gerenciamento de contêineres.


100% Remoto!

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Ambiência- Arquitetura
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
  • Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
  • Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.


Requisitos:

  • Superior completo em Arquitetura, hotelaria ou turismo;
  • Domínio dos softwares AutoCAD e SketchUp;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Power BI será um diferencial;
  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas à gestão da qualidade e atendimento em shopping centers ou em setores similares;
  • Conhecimento de regulamentações e normas de segurança e qualidade.


Nossos benefícios:


  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte/Estacionamento;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • WellHurb;
  • Auxílio Farmácia;
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Acolhe (serviço de apoio psicossocial);
  • Saber Online (plataforma interna de aprendizagem);
  • Bônus Anual


Local de Trabalho: Boulevard Feira de Santana

Through our deep business knowledge, operational excellence, and cutting-edge solutions – we help companies across industries get ahead and stay ahead. Job Title: Project Control Analyst -

Location: Brazil

Type: Fulltime (Remote)

Language Required - English (Professional)


Responsibilities:

Job Description Summary


Job Description

  • This role is embedded in the team global service organization as a business partner, reporting to the PCA Manager and indirectly to the Regional Finance Leader.
  • Should have good experience in SAP, Earned value management and Project Controls.
  • The project control analyst will be responsible to support regional project control initiatives & drive standardization of PCA processes using applied on-the-job standard work.
  • The mission specifically includes:
  • Develop and harmonies PCA Processes / Workflows.
  • Support Continuous Improvement Initiatives on PCA / Finance topics.
  • Actively track and manage to the PCA KPI’s.
  • Work Closely with the Project Management Office to:
  • Manage, track and provide analysis on support contracts and projects (sales, forecast estimates to complete, actuals, cost reconciliations, risks and opportunities, cash forecasts).
  • Performs financial analysis (budget deviations and identify root causes) for Project Manager, Project Management Office and HQ reporting.
  • Enters and maintains all project financial data in ERP (orders, invoicing, budgets, purchase requisitions).
  • Support invoicing and cash collection of project and support contracts.
  • Deliver monthly close of assigned business units by country and communicate any exceptions.


Further Essential Responsibilities

  • Drive PCA Lessons Learned and improve efficiency, actively engage in the Continuous Improvement and further Lean Initiatives
  • Ensure compliance to the Global Standard process for Project Controls
  • Support PM to align P6 project budgets to as sold in the ERP system
  • Liaison with Central Quality function to ensure alignment of regional best practices to global Quality standards
  • Liaison with other appropriate Teams within the Region e.g. Comm Ops, Finance, Sales required in the formation of the End-to-End Project Control

Processes.

  • Participate in Project reviews as part of the Leader Standard Work, to ensure the application of the defined Project Control approach.


Qualifications/Requirements

  • Fluent in English.
  • SAP Super User (preferred)
  • Excellent excel, Smartsheet or equivalent.
  • Strong Project Financial Management background (5 years’ experience).
  • Strong experience in used PCA tools and related processes.
  • Previous work experience in multi-cultural global environment.
  • Personally, capable to drive changes through functional reporting lines and manage by influence.


Why join Genpact?

· Be a transformation leader – Work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation

· Make an impact – Drive change for global enterprises and solve business challenges that matter

· Accelerate your career – Get hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning opportunities

· Work with the best – Join 140,000+ bold thinkers and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day

· Thrive in a values-driven culture – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress

Come join the tech shapers and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.


Let’s build tomorrow together.

Location-based Roles “Los Angeles, California based candidates are not eligible for this role.

Job Title: Project Control Analyst -

Location: Brazil

Type: Fulltime (Remote)

Language Required - English (Professional)


Responsibilities:

Job Description Summary


Job Description

  • This role is embedded in the team global service organization as a business partner, reporting to the PCA Manager and indirectly to the Regional Finance Leader.
  • Should have good experience in SAP, Earned value management and Project Controls.
  • The project control analyst will be responsible to support regional project control initiatives & drive standardization of PCA processes using applied on-the-job standard work.
  • The mission specifically includes:
  • Develop and harmonies PCA Processes / Workflows.
  • Support Continuous Improvement Initiatives on PCA / Finance topics.
  • Actively track and manage to the PCA KPI’s.
  • Work Closely with the Project Management Office to:
  • Manage, track and provide analysis on support contracts and projects (sales, forecast estimates to complete, actuals, cost reconciliations, risks and opportunities, cash forecasts).
  • Performs financial analysis (budget deviations and identify root causes) for Project Manager, Project Management Office and HQ reporting.
  • Enters and maintains all project financial data in ERP (orders, invoicing, budgets, purchase requisitions).
  • Support invoicing and cash collection of project and support contracts.
  • Deliver monthly close of assigned business units by country and communicate any exceptions.


Further Essential Responsibilities

  • Drive PCA Lessons Learned and improve efficiency, actively engage in the Continuous Improvement and further Lean Initiatives
  • Ensure compliance to the Global Standard process for Project Controls
  • Support PM to align P6 project budgets to as sold in the ERP system
  • Liaison with Central Quality function to ensure alignment of regional best practices to global Quality standards
  • Liaison with other appropriate Teams within the Region e.g. Comm Ops, Finance, Sales required in the formation of the End-to-End Project Control

Processes.

  • Participate in Project reviews as part of the Leader Standard Work, to ensure the application of the defined Project Control approach.


Qualifications/Requirements

  • Fluent in English.
  • SAP Super User (preferred)
  • Excellent excel, Smartsheet or equivalent.
  • Strong Project Financial Management background (5 years’ experience).
  • Strong experience in used PCA tools and related processes.
  • Previous work experience in multi-cultural global environment.
  • Personally, capable to drive changes through functional reporting lines and manage by influence.

title: 10869 - Cientista de Dados
description:
Principais responsabilidades :

  • Profissional atuará como Cientista de Dados, atuando com realização do ajuste fino (fine-tuning) de modelos pré-treinados com bases de dados internas ou públicas, aplicando técnicas como LoRA, PEFT e distilação, quando necessário;
  • Aplicar engenharia de prompts para otimizar interações com LLMs via APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Cohere, Hugging Face, etc);
  • Implementar pipelines inteligentes com ETL automatizado, utilizando boas práticas de versionamento de dados e reprodutibilidade;
  • Integrar modelos em fluxos de negócio utilizando frameworks como LangChain e APIs REST/GraphQL;
  • Analisar resultados, definir métricas de sucesso e realizar validações contínuas dos modelos (F1, BLEU, perplexidade);
  • Gerar relatórios e dashboards com insights dos modelos usando SQL e Looker Studio.


Conhecimentos Específicos:

  • Atuação anterior em projetos com modelos generativos ou LLMs aplicados em produção;
  • Vivência com ajuste fino (fine-tuning) de modelos pré-treinados com dados próprios;
  • Experiência na integração de modelos via APIs e serviços web;
  • Experiência com deploy de soluções baseadas em IA;
  • Python avançado com experiência em pandas, numpy, LangChain, asyncio;
  • Conhecimento prático em scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch;
  • Experiência com APIs de LLMs e ferramentas como Hugging Face Transformers;
  • Conhecimento em Git;
  • Construção e manutenção de pipelines de ETL de dados;
  • Familiaridade avançada com SQL para consultas e extração de dados;
  • Experiência com Looker Studio para visualização e monitoramento de dados/modelos;
  • Graduação completa.


✔Contratação: CLT + Benefícios

✔Atuação 100% Home-Office com idas esporádicas ao escritório - São Paulo (Centro)/SP.

Seeking a Business Data Analyst (Based in Brazil): Rhino, are you there?


At WE ARE META, we focus on finding the perfect match between our Rhinos and our clients.


Why join us?

  • Expand your network: As a consultant at We Are META, you’ll have access to a network of national and international partners across diverse sectors of the tech industry.
  • Enjoy our perks: When you join the crash you’ll have an array of benefits , to help you achieve the best work-life balance.
  • Get your perfect match: Our recruiters do their best to get the best position for you, whether in terms of working policy (remote, hybrid, on-site) or the company’s culture .
  • Personalized support: With our career coach , we assure that all your needs are being met and you’re being provided everything you need to excel in your professional life because the well-being of our Rhinos is our number one priority.


Perks of becoming a Rhino:

  • You’ll get a welcome kit
  • Opportunities for career progression
  • Live on the edge with our health insurance
  • Coverflex meal card
  • Other protocols and special discounts


For this position, the perfect Rhino should have the following skills:

  • 4+ years of professional experience as Business (Data) Analyst;
  • Experience managing data gathering for material and product master creation;
  • Proficiency with workflow tools or manual input methods for data creation and updates;
  • Experience with Winshuttle and Change Request (CR) Reporting Tool;
  • Knowledge of Global Attributes collection and approval processes (MEWS flow);
  • Familiarity with IDOC issue resolution, reporting, and Data Quality Tools (DQTs);
  • Experience performing data quality checks and maintaining master data accuracy;
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills;
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1 Level);
  • Mandatory residency in Brazil;
  • Availability to work remotely from Brazil.

title: PHP Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for PHP Senior Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Able to work independently with minimal supervision, as well as collaborate with a diverse team.

- Accountable for resolution of the most technically challenging issues facing the organization.

- Write code with increasing quality and maintainability.

- Guide the architecture of large features which impact all parts of the company, identifying issues and raising concerns/blockers for mitigation.

- Research and introduce new technology to improve the applications and/or the development pipeline.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience working with PHP with strong Front-End skills.

- Workflow Management, design and implementation in all its stages.

- Collaboration with the development team in the achievement of technical challenges, code upgrades, working closely with architects, developers, business analysts, testers and product owners.

- Contribution to the preparation of technical documentation.

- Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and other frameworks such as, among others, Angular and React.

- Experience with frameworks such as Zend, Laravel, Symphony is desirable.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Business Controller / CFO (Executive Leadership Program Track - Latin) – Global Industrial Leader
description:
Senior Business Controller (Executive Leadership Program Track) – Global Industrial Leader


Location: Initial landing role in Hong Kong or other key cities (depending on where you are), with potential rotations globally

Company: A globally integrated industrial leader with end-to-end value chain excellence


Your Mission:

Shape financial excellence for a multinational industrial powerhouse and accelerate your trajectory as a future enterprise leader. As the cornerstone of our executive development pipeline, you will partner with C-suite stakeholders to drive strategic alignment, optimize risk-resilient governance, and fuel sustainable value creation across HQ and regional operations. This role is your launchpad to broader executive responsibilities within 18–24 months.


Core Responsibilities:

Strategic Financial Leadership

  • Reinvent budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow optimization for industrial complexes and business units.
  • Fortify integrated risk frameworks (finance/tax/legal/compliance) while preserving operational agility.
  • Advise on M&A, investments, and market expansion through a value-creation lens.


Operational Transformation

  • Oversee accounting operations, ensuring flawless adherence to global policies and controls.
  • Optimize statutory/tax compliance and finance/legal structures across jurisdictions.
  • Partner with plant leadership on CAPEX strategy, scalability, and ROI-driven execution.


Stakeholder & Risk Stewardship

  • Cultivate strategic relationships with regulators, auditors, and advisors across selected locations.
  • Manage external vendors to balance cost efficiency with premium quality.
  • Champion finance perspectives in C-suite forums as a trusted enterprise advisor.


Talent & Culture Catalyst

  • Mentor high-potential finance teams in business partnering and strategic analysis.
  • Instill a culture of precision, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration.


Pathway to Executive Leadership

  • Excel in this high-visibility controller role for 18–24 months before rotating into broader enterprise leadership
  • Gain exposure to board-level decision-making, M&A integration, and pan-Asian P&L management.


Required Expertise:

Non-Negotiables

  • 10+ years’ progressive finance leadership, including 5+ years as Head of Controlling/Regional Controller in industrial/manufacturing sectors.
  • Professional Credentials: ACCA, HKICPA, CPA, or equivalent.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Finance, Accounting, or related field from a top-tier institution.
  • Language: Fluent English and Mandarin a must, Portuguese a strong plus


Proven Impact

  • Mastery of complex accounting, tax structuring, and internal control frameworks.
  • Track record in M&A due diligence, cash flow transformation, and enterprise risk mitigation.
  • Success in matrixed, privately held organizations with legacy operations.


Leadership DNA

  • Architect, not just operator: Strengthens foundations while designing future-ready solutions.
  • Ambassador: Influences stakeholders with integrity, diplomacy, and executive presence.
  • Accelerator: Develops talent and drives continuous improvement as a cultural cornerstone.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Facilitar cerimônias Scrum: Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews e Retrospectives.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e execução de PI (Program Increment).
  • Atuar como servant leader e coach para um ou mais times ágeis dentro de um SAFe Agile Release Train (ART).
  • Identificar e remover impedimentos que afetem o progresso do time.
  • Fomentar colaboração e comunicação entre times e stakeholders.
  • Acompanhar e reportar métricas do time para promover transparência e melhoria contínua.
  • Garantir alinhamento com os objetivos do ART e apoiar a entrega de metas em nível de programa.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência atuando como Scrum Master em ambiente SAFe.
  • Conhecimento sólido em princípios e práticas ágeis.
  • Habilidade para remover impedimentos e facilitar o trabalho em equipe.
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multifuncionais.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência prévia em Program Increment (PI) Planning.
  • Certificações em práticas ágeis (Scrum Master, SAFe, etc.).
  • Perfil colaborativo e orientado à melhoria contínua.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.


Regime de Contratação

CLT

title: Closer de alta performance
description:
Closer –  Formato: RemotoTipo de Contrato: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)Área: Comercial / VendasNível: Júnior
Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Closer de alta performance , com foco em conversão de leads qualificados e vendas consultivas de alto valor. O profissional será responsável pelo momento mais estratégico da jornada do cliente: o fechamento . Atuará com autonomia, metas claras e liberdade para acelerar resultados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:
  • Conduzir reuniões de fechamento com leads qualificados, com foco total em conversão.
  • Diagnosticar dores e necessidades do lead para propor soluções personalizadas.
  • Negociar propostas e acompanhar objeções com postura consultiva.
  • Utilizar o CRM Kommo para organizar o pipeline e garantir o follow-up dos leads.
  • Elaborar relatórios de desempenho e previsões de vendas.
  • Colaborar com o time para otimizar processos e aumentar o volume de vendas fechadas.

    • Requisitos
    • Experiência comprovada com fechamento de vendas (closer) .
    • Excelente comunicação e escuta ativa.
    • Organização e foco em metas.
    • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM e rotina de vendas remota.
    • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia e disciplina.




    Diferenciais
    • Vivência com vendas de produtos ou serviços digitais (SaaS, consultorias, plataformas).
    • Conhecimento sobre técnicas de vendas como SPIN, BANT ou similares.
    • Interesse no setor de engenharia, tecnologia ou inovação.

    • Comportamentos esperados
    • Ambição por resultados e mentalidade orientada a metas.
    • Perfil consultivo, com empatia e foco em gerar valor para o lead.
    • Proatividade, organização e postura profissional.
    • Capacidade de lidar com pressão sem perder a qualidade no atendimento.
    • Vontade real de crescer junto com o negócio.

    • Modelo de Trabalho
    • 100% presencial, flexibilidade total de horário .
    • Foco em performance e entregas (não controlamos horário, controlamos resultado).
    • Reporte diário de atendimentos e status de negociações.

    • Remuneração 


    • Modelo de pagamento: Fixo + Comissão (PJ)
    • Fixo mensal: R$ 1700,00
    • Comissão: 5% sobre vendas fechadas
    • Ticket médio: de R$ 1500,00 a R$ 3000,00

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Data Engineer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

title: Desenvolvedor .Net
description:
Sobre a FourD :

Nosso propósito é apoiar nossos clientes na implementação de produtos financeiros e em melhorias de jornadas. Trabalhamos com NuBank, Banco Next e Natura Pay...


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com .NET Core / ASP.NET.
  • Domínio de C#, APIs RESTful e padrões como DTOs.
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de APIs (ApiVersioning, rotas versionadas).
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais.
  • Domínio em Git e controle de versão.
  • Experiência com integração de APIs, sistemas externos e micro serviços.
  • Boa comunicação e adaptabilidade a diferentes projetos e linguagens.
  • Experiência com autenticação/autorização (JWT, OAuth2)
  • Vivência com testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas e manipulação de dados externos.
  • Espanhol avançado


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com arquitetura limpa (Clean Architecture) e arquitetura hexagonal
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento, logging e observabilidade (Serilog, Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana).
  • Familiaridade com mensageria (AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Kafka, RabbitMQ) e padrões como Circuit Breaker e Retry.
  • Experiência com gestão de secrets e configuração segura em ambientes diversos.


Modelo de Contração: PJ

title: User Experience Specialist - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a User Experience Specialist to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language, and oriented to provide the best experience to the end-user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work collaboratively with one or more scrum teams and iterate the UX design in an agile model.

- Work with customers to understand real requirements from a UX point of view, and can predicate potential UX changes from experience.

- Prototype quick mockups for any initial design, and get feedback from customers to iterate.

- Design high-quality UI according to modern design principles for commercial software.

- Illustrate and optimize software workflows for the best of UX.


Requirements:


- 6+ years of experience working as a developer.

- 5+ years of experience in UX/UI.

- Proficient with analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving.

- Hands-on experience with managing data loads and data quality is a plus.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Informações da empresa:

Somos uma empresa de educação que oferece cursos e pós graduação voltado a área da saúde para médicos, biomédicos, enfermeiro e demais profissionais da área da saúde.


  • Missão: Gerar oportunidades de crescimento e mudança de vida para profissionais da área da saúde que buscam sucesso e satisfação pessoal e financeira.
  • Visão: Ser a empresa referência no setor de educação para saúde e impactar mais de 100.000 vidas e 5.000 profissionais
  • Valores: Clientes no centro, verdade, ambição e sentimento de melhorias, colaboração Etc.

title: Arquiteto/Tech Lead – Sistemas de Autorização (ISO 8583)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Responsabilidades e atribuições


O que esperamos que você realize:

Responsável por liderar a arquitetura, evolução técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de sistemas críticos de autorização de transações financeiras, com foco em alta disponibilidade, performance e segurança. Atuará como referência técnica para o time, garantindo a aderência aos padrões de mercado e a integração eficiente com sistemas de pagamento baseados no protocolo ISO 8583.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de sistemas de autorização financeira baseados em ISO 8583.
  • Liderar decisões técnicas e orientar o time no desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Garantir a integração eficiente com terminais, adquirentes e emissores via mensagens ISO 8583.
  • Projetar e revisar modelos de dados em Oracle, otimizando consultas SQL e PL/SQL.
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de vida de aplicações em ambientes WebSphere e JBoss.
  • Promover a adoção de microserviços com Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Data e Security.
  • Estabelecer e manter pipelines de CI/CD com Azure DevOps e infraestrutura em AWS.
  • Definir estratégias de conteinerização com Docker e orquestração com Kubernetes.
  • Documentar e versionar APIs RESTful e SOAP com Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Aplicar padrões de design e boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Atuar como facilitador técnico em squads ágeis, promovendo colaboração e entrega contínua.
